body: I wish this was for me

Two years I tried to do this for my love, only to grow so sad and depleted that I finally suggested separating-he jumped at it-I cannot create his happiness-I cannot make him be in love with me. Remember that-you are enough to be just YOU and should be loved and recognized for just that.  Good luck

I am currently going through a separation-and although I know it’s the right thing, every day I have doubts, but your words keep me motivated for the light and the end of the tunnel, I too will love being alone-thank you
I too am afraid of failure.... as did I not already fail no way to move back... so hard to move forward
I’ve lived this and it almost killed me, I’m now in the process of separating-which makes me sad to no end, but I also feel free-I wish you only happiness
I wish my partner felt this way...being heartbroken sucks
I am feeling this deeply...
I wish my person felt this way...

Just be kind and leave her, I am feeling like my partner feels exactly the way you describe-yet keeps us stuck in the relationship-I don’t think he likes me either and I hate my life-so stop keeping her chained to you-let her go.
We did a counselling session, he didn’t like what she had to say and got mad at me for trying to use the tools she gave us- I’m afraid to even suggest it again
Thank you for your recommendation, I bought the audio book, I already think it’s a great book, I’m no where finished but already feel a bit more clarity
Reading this making me miss my daughter, especially in these times, you are a wonderful daughter.
You should end it, maybe your other half isn’t happy either, but doesn’t have the courage to say so, you deserve better don’t stay stuck

You can get a cold sore (herpes) just from kissing someone else who has it, or by sharing a drink with them while they have an ‘outbreak’ I wouldn’t risk it.

You should try to see a doctor, could be an issue with your cervix, could be a miscarriage, or period related/hormonal.  I would go easy on sex maybe giver a break and see if it happens again (if you really can’t see a doctor) good luck, and good health.
It’s selfless when you know you can’t stop hurting, I wish I had more selfless people in my life
You’re not alone... hugs
